title: DaT Parkinson — synthetic demo
objective: Improve a reproducible binary-classification baseline on synthetic image-inspired features while minimizing log loss and never using or exposing restricted challenge data.
research_protocol: Before the first experiment, read the public official challenge pages, document the metric, submission format, and execution constraints, then research comparable public methods. Cite sources and distinguish facts from hypotheses.
data_policy: Never open, attach, copy, or send restricted DrivenData scans or files to an AI provider. Only code, synthetic data, aggregate metrics, and sanitized logs may enter a prompt.
